fields.name: restrictGlobalConfig
docs: Whether the platform restricts the global config used to create pools with this
platform config, 0: no restriction, 1: only the allowed global config can be used,

fields.name: restrictCurveParam
docs: Whether the platform restricts the launch params of the pools created with this
platform config, 0: no restriction, 1: the launch params must satisfy the

fields.name: curveRuleManager
docs: The wallet allowed to manage the `PlatformCurveRule` accounts of this platform
config, the platform admin is often a multisig wallet which is inconvenient for
the day to day rule changes. The platform admin can always manage the rules too,
and it is the only one that can set this wallet.

instructions.name: buyExactIn
docs: Use the given amount of quote tokens to purchase base tokens.
# Arguments
* `ctx` - The context of accounts
* `amount_in` - Amount of quote token to purchase
* `minimum_amount_out` - Minimum amount of base token to receive (slippage protection)
* `share_fee_rate` - Fee rate for the share

accounts.name: payer
docs: The user performing the swap operation
Must sign the transaction and pay for fees

accounts.name: authority
docs: PDA that acts as the authority for pool vault operations
Generated using AUTH_SEED

accounts.name: globalConfig
docs: Global configuration account containing protocol-wide settings
Used to read protocol fee rates and curve type

accounts.name: platformConfig
docs: Platform configuration account containing platform-wide settings
Used to read platform fee rate

accounts.name: poolState
docs: The pool state account where the swap will be performed
Contains current pool parameters and balances

accounts.name: userBaseToken
docs: The user's token account for base tokens (tokens being bought)
Will receive the output tokens after the swap

accounts.name: userQuoteToken
docs: The user's token account for quote tokens (tokens being sold)
Will be debited for the input amount

accounts.name: baseVault
docs: The pool's vault for base tokens
Will be debited to send tokens to the user

accounts.name: quoteVault
docs: The pool's vault for quote tokens
Will receive the input tokens from the user

accounts.name: baseTokenMint
docs: The mint of the base token
Used for transfer fee calculations if applicable

accounts.name: quoteTokenMint
docs: The mint of the quote token
Used for transfer fee calculations if applicable

accounts.name: baseTokenProgram
docs: Token program owning the base token: either SPL Token or Token-2022

accounts.name: quoteTokenProgram
docs: Token program owning the quote token: either SPL Token or Token-2022

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} buys at least ${data.minimumAmountOut} of ${accounts.baseTokenMint} for ${data.amountIn} of ${accounts.quoteTokenMint} in pool ${accounts.poolState}

This can be any account with sufficient SOL to cover the transaction

accounts.name: globalConfig
docs: Global configuration account containing protocol-wide settings
Includes settings like quote token mint and fee parameters

accounts.name: platformConfig
docs: Platform configuration account containing platform info
Includes settings like the fee_rate, name, web, img of the platform

accounts.name: authority
docs: PDA that acts as the authority for pool vault and mint operations
Generated using AUTH_SEED

accounts.name: poolState
docs: Account that stores the pool's state and parameters
PDA generated using POOL_SEED and both token mints

accounts.name: baseMint
docs: The mint for the base token (token being sold)
Created in this instruction with specified decimals

accounts.name: quoteMint
docs: The mint for the quote token (token used to buy)
Must match the quote_mint specified in global config

accounts.name: baseVault
docs: Token account that holds the pool's base tokens
PDA generated using POOL_VAULT_SEED

accounts.name: quoteVault
docs: Token account that holds the pool's quote tokens
PDA generated using POOL_VAULT_SEED

accounts.name: metadataAccount
docs: Account to store the base token's metadata
Created using Metaplex metadata program

accounts.name: baseTokenProgram
docs: SPL Token program for the base token
Must be the standard Token program

accounts.name: quoteTokenProgram
docs: Token program owning the quote token: either SPL Token or Token-2022

accounts.name: metadataProgram
docs: Metaplex Token Metadata program
Used to create metadata for the base token

accounts.name: systemProgram
docs: Required for account creation

accounts.name: rentProgram
docs: Required for rent exempt calculations

instructions.name: migrateToCpswap
docs: # Arguments
* `ctx` - The context of accounts

docs: Only migrate_to_cpswap_wallet can migrate to cpswap pool
This signer must match the migrate_to_cpswap_wallet saved in global_config

docs: The mint for the base token (token being sold)
May be owned by either token program, the instruction picks the matching one

accounts.name: quoteMint

May be owned by either token program, the instruction picks the matching one

accounts.name: platformConfig
docs: Platform configuration account containing platform-wide settings
Used to read platform fee rate

accounts.name: cpswapPool
docs: PDA account:
seeds = [
b"pool",
cpswap_config.key().as_ref(),
token_0_mint.key().as_ref(),
token_1_mint.key().as_ref(),
seeds::program = cpswap_program,
Or random account: must be signed by cli

accounts.name: authority
docs: PDA that acts as the authority for pool vault operations

docs: Account that stores the pool's state and parameters

docs: The pool's vault for base tokens
Will be fully drained during migration

accounts.name: quoteVault
docs: The pool's vault for quote tokens
Will be fully drained during migration

accounts.name: tokenProgram
docs: The legacy SPL Token program.
Always required: the cpswap lp mint and the locked liquidity fee NFT live on it, and it
serves the base or quote token whenever that mint is a legacy mint.

accounts.name: tokenProgram2022
docs: The Token-2022 program, serving the base or quote token when that mint is a
Token-2022 mint. Always required, even when neither mint uses it.

docs: Program to create an ATA for receiving fee NFT

docs: Required for account creation

accounts.name: rentProgram
docs: Required for rent exempt calculations

docs: Program to create NFT metadata accunt

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} moves the liquidity of pool ${accounts.poolState} to the new Raydium CP swap pool ${accounts.cpswapPool}

docs: Accounts read after the named ones (ten in the migrations sampled), whose order the
published interface does not give: the mint (a new signer), token account, Raydium lock
record and metadata of the platform's locked-liquidity NFT and the wallet that receives it,
the CP swap permission record that lets LaunchLab create the pool, and CP swap's records
of supported Token-2022 mints.

instructions.name: sellExactIn
docs: Use the given amount of base tokens to sell for quote tokens.
# Arguments
* `ctx` - The context of accounts
* `amount_in` - Amount of base token to sell
* `minimum_amount_out` - Minimum amount of quote token to receive (slippage protection)
* `share_fee_rate` - Fee rate for the share

accounts.name: payer
docs: The user performing the swap operation
Must sign the transaction and pay for fees

accounts.name: authority
docs: PDA that acts as the authority for pool vault operations
Generated using AUTH_SEED

accounts.name: globalConfig
docs: Global configuration account containing protocol-wide settings
Used to read protocol fee rates and curve type

accounts.name: platformConfig
docs: Platform configuration account containing platform-wide settings
Used to read platform fee rate

accounts.name: poolState
docs: The pool state account where the swap will be performed
Contains current pool parameters and balances

accounts.name: userBaseToken
docs: The user's token account for base tokens (tokens being bought)
Will receive the output tokens after the swap

accounts.name: userQuoteToken
docs: The user's token account for quote tokens (tokens being sold)
Will be debited for the input amount

accounts.name: baseVault
docs: The pool's vault for base tokens
Will be debited to send tokens to the user

accounts.name: quoteVault
docs: The pool's vault for quote tokens
Will receive the input tokens from the user

accounts.name: baseTokenMint
docs: The mint of the base token
Used for transfer fee calculations if applicable

accounts.name: quoteTokenMint
docs: The mint of the quote token
Used for transfer fee calculations if applicable

accounts.name: baseTokenProgram
docs: Token program owning the base token: either SPL Token or Token-2022

accounts.name: quoteTokenProgram
docs: Token program owning the quote token: either SPL Token or Token-2022

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} sells ${data.amountIn} of ${accounts.baseTokenMint} for at least ${data.minimumAmountOut} of ${accounts.quoteTokenMint} in pool ${accounts.poolState}

docs: The accounts the program reads after the named ones, in order: the share fee recipient,
only when the share fee rate is above zero; then the System program, the platform fee vault
(seeds: platform config, quote mint) and the creator fee vault (seeds: pool creator, quote mint).

instructions.name: updatePlatformCurveRule
docs: Add or replace one check group of the launch param rule.
The constraints of a group must all hold together, a launch is allowed when it
satisfies any group, a group with no constraint allows everything.
# Arguments
* `ctx` - The context of accounts
* `group_id` - The stable id of the group, an existing group with the id is replaced
* `constraints` - The constraints of the group, see `param_field` and `param_op`

definedTypes.name: ammCreatorFeeOn
docs: migrate to cpmm, creator fee on quote token or both token

definedTypes.name: curveRuleGroup
docs: A set of constraints that must all hold together, e.g.
`supply = 50W && total_base_sell >= 20W`.

fields.name: groupId
docs: The stable id of the group, used to update or remove it

fields.name: epoch
docs: The epoch the group was written

fields.name: constraints
docs: The constraints of the group, an empty list allows everything

definedTypes.name: migrateNftInfo
docs: Represents the parameters for initializing a platform config account(Only support MigrateType::CPSWAP)
# Fields
* `platform_scale` - Scale of the platform liquidity quantity rights will be converted into NFT
* `creator_scale` - Scale of the token creator liquidity quantity rights will be converted into NFT
* `burn_scale` - Scale of liquidity directly to burn
* platform_scale + creator_scale + burn_scale = RATE_DENOMINATOR_VALUE

definedTypes.name: mintParams
docs: Represents the parameters for initializing a new token mint
# Fields
* `decimals` - Number of decimal places for the token
* `name` - Name of the token
* `symbol` - Symbol/ticker of the token
* `uri` - URI pointing to token metadata

definedTypes.name: paramConstraint
docs: A single check on one launch parameter, e.g. `(SUPPLY, GTE, 1_000_000)`.
A range check is expressed with two constraints(`GTE` + `LTE`) in the same group.

fields.name: field
docs: The parameter this constraint applies to, see `param_field`

fields.name: op
docs: The comparison operator, see `param_op`

fields.name: value
docs: The value to compare the actual launch parameter with

definedTypes.name: platformParams
docs: Represents the parameters for initializing a platform config account
# Fields
* `migrate_nft_info` - The platform configures liquidity info during migration(Only support MigrateType::CPSWAP)
* `fee_rate` - Fee rate of the platform
* `name` - Name of the platform
* `web` - Website of the platform
* `img` - Image link of the platform
/// * `creator_fee_rate` - The fee rate charged by the creator for each transaction.

definedTypes.name: poolStatus
docs: Represents the different states a pool can be in
* Fund - Initial state where pool is accepting funds
* Migrate - Pool funding has ended and waiting for migration
* Trade - Pool migration is complete and amm trading is enabled

definedTypes.name: tradeDirection
docs: Specifies the direction of a trade in the bonding curve
This is important because curves can treat tokens differently through weights or offsets

fields.name: transferFeeBasisPoints
docs: denominator is 10000, currently, this value cannot exceed 5%, which is 500.

fields.name: maximumFee
docs: Maximum fee on each transfers, the value must exceed supply * transfer_fee_basis_points / 10000

fields.name: allocatedShareAmount
docs: Total allocated share amount of the base token, not greater than total_locked_amount
